The reference computes percentile thresholds from session-wide 50 ms bin means over the whole session grid, then applies them per trial. The AI instead computes thresholds from visible bin means only within the kept converted trials and explicitly changed the method to force a 40/20/40 visible-bin split. That optimizes label balance rather than matching the reference processing.
